limitations: The original strong candidates remain ineligible; this protocol never authorizes biological readiness and defines no final test.
All groups have one reported Sfp1/context/glucose schedule. No dose response, causal glucose effect, universal mechanism or intrinsic kinetic parameter is identified.
The historical published cohort and processing may depend on future observations; this is not a certified prospective forecast from untouched acquisitions.
Targets are means of individual raw max5/median ratios among the fixed prefix cohort observed at each frame, not individual trajectories, ratios of mean intensities or phosphorylation fractions.

Finite-cell sampling, within-movie dependence, measurement/calibration error, day/strain effects, attrition and inherited processing-selection bias are distinct; unmeasured components remain unresolved.
Cell sample SD is descriptive, not a biological confidence interval or SD/sqrt(cell count) uncertainty estimate.
Local digests and accountable operational custody are not external registration, encryption, adversarial isolation or a scientific authorization.
environment.observation_transform: identity raw individual max5/median ratios; prefix mean is a conditioning input

optimizer_settings.jacobian: analytic; derivative of the nonnegative map is zero at and below zero
optimizer_settings.loss_evaluation_accounting: every residual invocation; analytic Jacobian calls are counted separately
optimizer_settings.output_map: max(0, unbounded_mean) before fitting and scoring
optimizer_settings.within_family_selection: finite successful minimum training MSE; numerical ties prefer lexicographic parameters then start index

provenance.refresh_requirement: POP001/POP003/POP004 fixes require a new code/configuration freeze, a new typed request, and an independently issued executor_refresh_admission_v1; existing source projections remain approved and must not be regenerated

source.field_policy: Derive the observable directly as max5/median from the two declared deposited intensity measurements. The supplied nucLoc column is not an alternate target or fallback. Do not subtract background without an independently specified adapter. Do not load mixed raw files into the learner or discover additional response paths recursively.
source.license: CC BY 4.0 as verified in repository metadata; retain attribution and source locators in exports/reports

record.scalar_policy: Direct equality to deposited max5/median/times at the declared pointers, including exact null retention. No response transformations, smoothing, interpolation or row renumbering.
